## Progress

- Merged [PR #41](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/41): React Router 8.4; pure navigation map filters items by capability and tenant flag, and routes exist only for visible items; navy sidebar from 1280 px, 72 px icon rail 768–1279 px, bottom tabs below 768 px plus `/more`; disabled bell placeholder; skip link, `nav` landmark, white focus ring on navy; strings in en/hi/ar
- 7 Vitest tests (mutation-checked) and Playwright with a mocked synthetic `/v1/me/context`: receptionist sees Practice only, doctor sees Clinical + Practice, flag-off items hidden, layout at 1366/900/375 px in English and Arabic, skip link first and focuses `main`, axe clean (skip-link test race on shell render fixed in `fix/MDV-P0-022-skip-link-flake`)
- Left (needs MDV-P0-012 and MDV-P0-028): demonstrating each role in the seeded tenant needs the server's `/v1/me/context` memberships, capabilities and flags plus seeded flags; today a real sign-in lands on the choose-facility placeholder

## Description

Navy sidebar (Clinical · Practice · Assistant · Admin groups) with module rail colours, facility name, signed-in user and role; tablet 72px icon rail; mobile bottom tabs (Today · Patients · Inbox · Messages · More). Items are filtered by the user's capabilities and by tenant feature flags (MDV-P0-028) so later-phase screens stay hidden. Notification bell placeholder (D-03 ships in P1).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A receptionist sees only Practice items (front desk, schedule, register) and never Clinical items.
- [ ] **AC2.** A doctor sees Clinical + Practice items allowed by the matrix; items behind disabled flags are not rendered.
- [ ] **AC3.** Layout switches at 768 px (rail) and 360–767 px (bottom tabs) per the responsive rules.
- [ ] **AC4.** Keyboard: skip-to-content link, visible focus, logical tab order; sidebar is a nav landmark.
- [ ] **AC5.** The day-one R0 capability "see role-based navigation" can be demonstrated for each role in the seeded tenant.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
